issues.description: Homepage URL (https://github.com/codecov/codecov-cli) does not match the source URL in conandata.yml (https://github.com/codecov/uploader). While notes.md explains that codecov-cli is actually the uploader project, the mismatch could confuse users tracking the upstream source repository.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider setting homepage to 'https://github.com/codecov/uploader' to match the actual source repository, or add a code comment explaining the relationship between codecov-cli and the uploader repo.

issues.description: Test only verifies exit code of 'codecov --version' without checking output content. While this is a valid smoke test that actually invokes the binary (R34 compliant — not a stub), it does not verify that the correct version string is printed. A broken binary that returns exit 0 with wrong output would pass.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider strengthening the test to verify output content, e.g.: self.run('codecov --version | grep 0.8.0', env='conanrun')
